Question: How do I permanently deactivate/close my postpaid connection?

Answer: Submit a closure request via Help > Account Services > Close Connection, or visit a store. Ensure all outstanding dues are cleared and any final bill is settled; the number enters a regulatory cooling-off period before being recycled.

Topic: Termination & Deactivation
title: How do I permanently deactivate/close my postpaid connection?
